function.name: inform
function.description: Answer a customer's QUESTION about the menu or options without ordering anything: what a category offers, sizes, temperatures, available options, whether something is offered, or details of one item. Only choose the topic and item; the app builds the answer from the menu. Never list menu items or options yourself.

topic.description: category_items = what a category (coffee/latte/tea/ade/dessert) has; sizes / temperatures / options = for one item (or in general); not_offered = whether something the customer named is offered (e.g. macaron, decaf); item_detail = about one menu item.

item.description: The menu item, the category, or the exact thing the customer asked about (in Korean). Omit for general questions.
